007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.agent;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.SelectAIAgent;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.Tool;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
013import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.SqlToolParams;
014import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.ToolAttributes;
015import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.ToolStatus;
016import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.ToolType;
017
018/**
019 * Creates a persistent SQL tool using typed {@link SqlToolParams}.
020 *
021 * <p>Set {@code SELECTAI_DB_USER}, {@code SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD},
022 * {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}, {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_NAME}, and
023 * {@code SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME}.
024 * The named Select AI profile must already exist and be accessible to the database user.</p>
025 *
026 * <p>Optionally set {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_INSTRUCTION} and
027 * {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_DESCRIPTION}. This sample creates a tool but
028 * does not run it or invoke its external service. Closing the client does not
029 * drop the tool. Run {@link DropToolSample} with the same tool name and database
030 * connection settings to remove it. Use a new tool name to avoid replacing
031 * an existing resource.</p>
032 *
033 * @see ToolParamsSample
034 */
035public final class CreateSqlToolSample {
036
037    private CreateSqlToolSample() {
038    }
039
040    /**
041     * Creates the configured tool without executing it.
042     *
043     * @param args unused command-line arguments
044     * @throws SelectAIException when an SDK operation fails; the process exits unsuccessfully
045     */
046    public static void main(String[] args) throws SelectAIException {
047        String toolName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_NAME");
048        SqlToolParams params = SqlToolParams.builder()
049                .profileName(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME"))
050                .build();
051        ToolAttributes attributes = ToolAttributes.builder()
052                .toolType(ToolType.SQL)
053                .toolParams(params)
054                .instruction(env("SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_INSTRUCTION"))
055                .build();
056
057        try (SelectAIAgent client = createClient()) {
058            Tool tool = client.tool(toolName, attributes,
059                    env("SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_DESCRIPTION"), ToolStatus.ENABLED);
060            System.out.printf("Create tool '%s' completed: %s%n", toolName, tool.create());
061        }
062    }
063
064    private static SelectAIAgent createClient() throws SelectAIException {
065        return SelectAIAgent.create(DbConnectionConfig.builder()
066                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
067                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
068                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
069                .build());
070    }
071
072    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
073        String value = env(name);
074        if (value == null) {
075            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
076        }
077        return value;
078    }
079
080    private static String env(String name) {
081        String value = System.getenv(name);
082        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? null : value;
083    }
084}
